_comment: CI regression thresholds for the metrics gated in docs/EVALUATION.md section 18.1. These values may only be TIGHTENED on the dev split (raising a quality floor, lowering a rate ceiling) when a run on the dev split justifies the new value. They must NEVER be relaxed to make a pull request pass. Relaxing a threshold requires all of: (1) a written justification in the pull-request description explaining why the previous threshold was wrong, (2) approval from a reviewer other than the author, (3) a re-baseline commit that archives a fresh full dev-split run as the new baseline, and (4) a changelog entry naming the old value, the new value and the reason. Held-out splits never set or validate a threshold.
